citations.claim: system energy at first pole_upright violation step shows runaway growth
cart position near track end while pole has fallen beyond limit

explanation: Controller with max coarse dt (0.02) and max sensor noise (0.02) saturates at force_limit 40 while light cart (0.5kg) with initial offset x=0.5,v=0.5,theta=0.1 diverges: by step 9 theta=-0.507, step10 theta=-0.688, step11 theta=-0.887 exceeding 0.8 rad limit. Noisy feedback plus large dt destabilizes state-feedback, saturating actuator and pumping energy (E~40.7) so pole falls.
vision_note: The pole leans progressively farther to the left from step 8 through step 10 while the cart remains right of center. At step 11 the pole has toppled sharply leftward and its tip turns red to mark the pole_upright violation.
